//: Single source of PROJECT-SPECIFIC configuration. Point the harness at a new application by editing ONLY this file. No values are hardcoded anywhere in the source.

navigation.//: 'reload' calls page.goto() for every route (works for any app, MPA or SPA). 'spa' uses history.pushState + popstate for same-document navigation after the first page (faster, opt-in, requires a true client-side router).

widgets.//: CSS selector(s) used by the Widget Behavior Engine's accordion check. Point this at your own design system's component if the generic default doesn't match.

auth.//: Optional interactive session capture (npm run save-auth) for apps that need a real login (SSO/ADFS/OAuth/etc.) before scanning. Independent of the scripted `login` block above.

autoFix.//: applyFixes: false (default) means npm run auto-fix never edits source — every fix, safe or unsafe, is reported only. Set true to make npm run auto-fix always write the small set of unambiguous, additive fixes (missing alt/aria-label/label/lang) directly to source, or leave false and use 'npm run auto-fix:apply' for a one-off apply run without changing this file.
